cheats.effect: Instantly adds $250,000 to your current character's bank account.
cheats.unlock_requirement: Complete the main story (or earn $250,000 via fencing).

cheats.name: No Fall Damage
cheats.effect: Prevents all health loss from falling.
cheats.unlock_requirement: Survive 20 free falls of at least 40 feet (12m).

cheats.name: Raise Heat Level
cheats.unlock_requirement: Lose a 3-star wanted level 25 times. (Sources disagree: some say escape rather than lose.)

cheats.name: Raise Wanted Level
cheats.effect: Raises your wanted level by one star.

cheats.name: Max Ammo
cheats.effect: Refills ammo for all carried weapons.
cheats.unlock_requirement: Earn 25 bronze-or-higher medals at the shooting range. (Tier mapping across Max/Infinite/No Reload is unconfirmed.)

cheats.name: Infinite Ammo
cheats.effect: Weapons never run out of ammo.
cheats.unlock_requirement: Earn 25 silver medals at the shooting range. (Unconfirmed tier mapping.)

cheats.name: No Reload
cheats.unlock_requirement: Earn 25 gold medals at the shooting range. (Unconfirmed tier mapping.)

cheats.name: Drunk
cheats.effect: Makes the screen and controls drunken.

cheats.name: Pinhole
cheats.effect: Applies a pinhole camera screen filter.
